translations.PRESET_DESC_DEFAULT: Classic dual-wing ergonomic layout: central navball with companion gauges, flanked by airspeed/altitude tapes and dynamic pressure/G-load dials.
translations.PRESET_DESC_MODERN: High-density glass cockpit suite featuring ELEC power distribution matrix and ROCKET 2D multistage propulsion stack.
translations.PRESET_DESC_APOLLO: Lunar landing mission panel focusing on descent TWR, radar altitude, stage propellant margins, and RCS attitude grid.
translations.PRESET_DESC_DEEP_SPACE: Deep space robotic probe suite: solar net charging telemetry, CommNet long-range array status, and orbital dynamics readouts.
translations.PRESET_DESC_SPACEX: Minimalist holographic touch cockpit: top panoramic telemetry header, central docking & attitude HUD reticle, lateral ECLSS life-support panel, and bottom pill control bar.
translations.PRESET_DESC_STARSHIP: Minimalist Starship HUD: arched G-meter tape, docking crosshair, and panoramic attitude.
translations.LIB_DESC_TAPE_SPD: 🛠️ PFD-style smooth vertical rolling tape gauge (left layout), supporting arbitrary physical data bindings and tick step calibration.
translations.LIB_DESC_TAPE_ALT: 🛠️ PFD-style smooth vertical rolling tape gauge (right layout), supporting ASL/AGL radar calibration.
translations.LIB_DESC_CARD_MULTI: 📝 2x3 flight telemetry matrix card: Out-of-the-box monitoring for speed, radar altitude, VSI, TWR, Q, and G-force with wildcard override support.
translations.LIB_DESC_CORE_NAVBALL: 🌐 Modern crisp vector/texture 3D navball core supporting stepless scaling, flight director crosshair, and full orbital maneuver vectors.
translations.LIB_DESC_VESSEL_NAVBALL: 🚀 Spherical attitude instrument centered on real-time 3D vessel model, surrounded by attitude sphere, artificial horizon ladder, SAS flight director, and navigation vectors.
translations.LIB_DESC_HEADING_ARC: 🧭 Primary Flight Display (PFD) smooth rolling heading tape arc with numerical readout and degree tick ladder.
translations.LIB_DESC_ND_NAV: 🧭 Aircraft avionics Navigation Display (ND) featuring compass arc, range rings, aircraft symbol, and waypoint flightplan.
translations.LIB_DESC_MANEUVER: 🎯 Live maneuver node indicator: remaining Delta-V progress bar, node countdown, burn duration, and instant prediction.
translations.LIB_DESC_MANEUVER_TL: ⏱️ Horizontal timeline maneuver indicator: ignition window track, T0 node point, and Prograde/Normal/Radial vector decomposition.
translations.LIB_DESC_ORBITAL_INFO: 🌐 Comprehensive orbital dynamics card: Apoapsis, Periapsis, burn countdowns, eccentricity, inclination, orbital period, and trajectory state pill.
translations.LIB_DESC_REF_FRAME: 🌐 Authoritative navigation reference frame indicator: vector icon atlas, frame type pill, central celestial body, and instantaneous physical speed. Supports click to cycle and right-click to open Principia window.
translations.TOOLTIP_REF_FRAME_DESC: Displays the active plotting and velocity reference frame (Inertial/Surface/Orbital/Lagrange/Target). Left-click to cycle frames, right-click to toggle Principia reference frame window.
translations.LIB_DESC_B747_EICAS: ✈️ Classic Boeing 747 quad-engine primary CRT: EPR/N1/EGT engine bar gauges, digital readouts, TAT/thrust rating, and gear status.
translations.LIB_DESC_B747_LOWER: ✈️ Classic Boeing 747 quad-engine lower CRT: N2/N3 tachometer bars, Fuel Flow (FF), oil pressure/temperature dual bugs, and vibration monitor.
translations.LIB_DESC_STAGE_SEQ: 🚀 Vertical rocket staging sequencer: per-stage remaining ΔV, burn time, TWR, and propellant gauge micro-bars, modernizing stock staging stack.
translations.LIB_DESC_ROCKET_2D: 🚀 Multistage rocket vertical propulsion stack with live propellant consumption gauges, engine status indicators, and stage dV.
translations.LIB_DESC_ELECTRICAL: ⚡ Battery voltage, DC ESS bus load, solar panel generation, and instantaneous net charge/discharge rate (EC/s).
translations.LIB_DESC_LIFE_SUPPORT: 🌱 Crew habitat cabin pressure, oxygen, electric charge, RCS, and life-support consumables 2x2 matrix gauges.
translations.LIB_DESC_COMMNET: 📡 Stock CommNet link status, control level, antenna array specs, and 5-bar signal strength meter.
translations.LIB_DESC_PERF_MON: ⚡ Real-time monitor for MFP telemetry, external probes, widget rendering overhead, and FPS, with 1-click full bypass.
translations.LIB_DESC_MASTER_WARN: 🚨 Dual-tier avionics annunciator: yellow Caution and red Warning dual-channel rotation with pull-up, stall, low-fuel, low-power, and hypoxia alerts; clickable to acknowledge.
translations.LIB_DESC_SPACEX_HDR: 🐉 SpaceX full-width top avionics status bar: active flight phase badge, mission timer, and 5 high-contrast orbital telemetry columns.
translations.LIB_DESC_SPACEX_DOCK: 🎯 SpaceX ISS docking reticle: concentric dual-ring boresight, 3-axis attitude deviation & rate, range closing rate, and RCS firing indicators.
translations.LIB_DESC_SPACEX_VIEW: 🌱 Vehicle overview & ECLSS monitor: cabin pressure, ppO2, cabin temp, bus power, airlock, propellant, and thermal status.

translations.LIB_DESC_SPACEX_TL: ⏱️ Horizontal Gantt mission timeline bar: dynamic cursor progression across MECO, staging, orbital insertion, and docking windows.
translations.LIB_DESC_UI_MGR: ❖ Flight HUD integrated UGUI manager widget: live widget roster, quick categories, 1-click visibility, and drag-and-drop orchestration.
translations.LIB_DESC_SAS_DIAL: 🧭 10-way full-featured rapid SAS mode selector dial with real-time vessel roll and stage silhouette.
translations.LIB_DESC_TOOLBAR: 📦 Ultramodern obsidian folding dock hosting 20+ stock and mod toolbar buttons, eliminating screen clutter.
translations.LIB_DESC_STAGE_CTRL: 🎮 Real-time Pitch/Roll/Yaw deflection indicators with staging safety lock (Alt+L) guard console.
translations.LIB_DESC_TIMEWARP: ⏩ Physics and orbital warp level indicator with 1-click smooth rate selector bar.

translations.THM_MODE_STOCK_TEX_DESC: • Uses stock KSP / TextureReplacer textures mapped via single-quad GPU raymarching and bilinear filtering; 100% authentic appearance with zero camera or 3D mesh overhead.
translations.THM_MODE_PROC_BAKE_DESC: • Procedural vectors are dynamically baked into a 2D equirectangular texture; minimal fragment shading cost with crisp aesthetics.
translations.THM_MODE_PROC_VEC_DESC: • Pure mathematical vector direct output via single-quad GPU raymarching; retina-crisp sharpness without distortion, zero camera or 3D mesh overhead.
translations.THM_MODE_STOCK_DIRECT_DESC: • Directly uses KSP's stock 3D NavBall, stripping side gauges and clutter to leave a floating sphere; fully integrated into MFP Edit Mode with free dragging and 8-point handle scaling.
translations.THM_PIPELINE_GPU_DESC: • [Modern GPU Single-Quad Procedural] Low-level shader acceleration evaluating card panels and primitives in fragment shaders, eliminating extra mesh vertices and canvas redraw overhead.
translations.THM_PIPELINE_UGUI_DESC: • [Classic UGUI Mesh Compatibility] Standard Unity UGUI image and mesh rendering providing maximum compatibility for legacy setups.
translations.THM_ENGINE_DESC: • Completely eliminates stock 2D texture dependency and polar UV distortion, delivering infinite retina vector precision.
